description: HUD FY2026 MTSP income limits for a county (town in New England): every level from 20% to 80% of area median for 1 to 8 persons, HERA Special limits where HUD lists them, the area median family income, and the maximum gross rent by bedroom count at each level (IRS Pub. 5913 method). Give state + county, or fips.

county.description: County name, e.g. "Harris County" or "Harris"; in New England, a town ("Boston"). Use fips when a name is ambiguous.

fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS (48201) or HUD's 10-digit area code (county + county subdivision, e.g. 2502507000 for Boston)

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code (CA, DC, PR) or name

name: get_income_limits
title: LIHTC income and rent limits
